sections.title: Supernovae Unite: Combining Pantheon+ and DES-SN5YR
sections.abstract: The authors combine Pantheon+ and DES-SN5YR into a consistently modelled sample of 2,884 likely Type-Ia supernovae and find that joint supernova, BAO, and CMB fits prefer time-varying dark energy over flat Lambda-CDM in frequentist analyses.
sections.claimed_result: The authors report Omega_m=0.310 in flat Lambda-CDM and a roughly 3.1–3.3 sigma frequentist preference for time-varying dark energy in combined fits.
sections.caveat: Bayesian evidence gives only weak preference; results depend on calibration, selection, bias corrections, host-galaxy modelling, and parameterization.

sections.title: Gravitationally Induced Entanglement Across an Event Horizon
sections.abstract: A gravitational time-delayed-potential model is used to argue that freely falling spatial superpositions can become entangled across an event horizon, with radial escape causing soft-graviton dephasing.
sections.claimed_result: The paper derives a dephasing bound in a constrained leading-quadrupole model and proposes a radial-versus-transverse geometric distinction for entanglement recovery.
sections.caveat: The result is model-dependent and is not an experimental observation.

sections.title: Strong suppression of the photonic density of states in three-dimensional disordered silicon networks
sections.abstract: Experiments and simulations on amorphous silicon gyroid networks show strongly reduced diffuse transmission and evidence for a deep photonic pseudogap.
sections.claimed_result: Polarization-resolved mid-infrared transmission supports a strongly suppressed photonic density of states and breakdown of conventional diffuse transport.
sections.caveat: The paper does not directly establish Anderson localization; finite-size and transport-interpretation issues remain.

sections.title: Percent-Level Prediction of the Deuteron Magnetic Polarizability
sections.abstract: An NNLO pionless-EFT calculation reduces the quoted uncertainty of the isovector magnetic-dipole contribution to deuteron magnetic polarizability from 4.9% to 1.3%.
sections.claimed_result: The authors obtain beta_M0=0.0789±0.0010 fm^3 and find expansion schemes agree to 0.165% at NNLO.
sections.caveat: High-precision experimental verification and residual EFT uncertainty assessment are still needed.

sections.title: Dead-zone-free free-induction-decay alkali-metal atomic magnetometer
sections.abstract: A Bell–Bloom FID scalar atomic magnetometer using a reflecting mirror and multipass cavity removes the detection dead zone and achieves better than 80 fT per square-root Hz sensitivity over all orientations.
sections.claimed_result: The sensor shows all-orientation operation, better than 80 fT/Hz^(1/2) sensitivity, and heading-error agreement with theory within 0.7 nT.
sections.caveat: Cross-talk, environmental noise, heading error, slew rate, and scaling to a robust vector instrument remain practical constraints.
